title: The “Source of Truth” Artifacts
use_cases: Use when establishing boundaries for AI content generation to prevent foundational errors
Configure when defining character motivations and internal conflicts to maintain consistency
Implement when transitioning between story batches to preserve the exact narrative state
Use when standardizing documentation structure across multiple writers using Markdown
content:
All our artifacts are pure markdown text, which gives us two things at once:

- Structure: we standardize which artifacts exist and the sections each artifact must include.
- Flexibility: within those sections, writers can add notes, nuance, and exceptions in plain text without fighting a rigid schema.

Conceptually each artifact follows a template like:

Story Bible: World rules (only if needed), tone, baseline lore, what cannot happen etc

Character Arcs: Who they are, their current motivation, internal confilcts etc.

Character Dynamics: Relationship “edges” (rivalry, loyalty, resentment, romance, etc.), behavioral constraints etc

Starting Point: The exact current state of the story at the beginning of this batch

These artifacts reduce drift and prevent the AI from “making up” foundational truth.
